KEEP THE INPUTS. CHANGE THE PROGRAM.

One city. Two ways through it.

Compare from the same starting point.

Run the original rule and your editor source in two fresh machines restored from the original open-bridge image, independently of your current workspace. Both receive the same three logical steps. Harbor Bridge stays open in both.

Fresh computation, not a recorded animation.

Change the world, separately.

Closing a bridge changes road data, not the rule. Vans already on it finish their segment. New routes use the updated road state.

The city has 16 nodes, 46 initial directed roads and three vans. It models route decisions and delivery progress; it does not model collisions or traffic.

THE CITY IS THE EXAMPLE. BRAINFUCK IS THE EXPERIMENT.

A useful system from eight instructions.

Thread gives you words.

Brainfuck moves a pointer, changes a cell, reads or writes a byte, and loops. Its eight instructions are > < + - . , [ ]. The BF kernel implements Thread, a small stack language. Build 002 adds a source workspace, typed module compilation, exact version links and reclaimable memory in Thread, executing inside that kernel.

When you apply a rule, BF stores the text, checks it, compiles a candidate and publishes a new version. Invalid source leaves the working version in place. One rollback version is retained; live calls and dependencies retain what they still need. Freed arenas can be used again.

The host makes it visible.

Python builds the initial BF kernel from an auditable generator. A generic JavaScript/WebAssembly executor runs the eight instructions. JavaScript sends raw input, saves opaque machine images and renders the BF output. It does not compile your module, solve routes or advance the city on its own.

The architecture and vehicle images are generated graphical assets. Roads, paths, counters and positions come from the running program. Smooth motion interpolates between observed positions; native logical steps can take seconds.

Open workspace tools & raw machine output

Named sources, inside BF

Open an existing module above, or create a pure 2-input / 1-output module. The city uses module 0. Other modules can be called by name in your rule.

Deleting a module with live pins or dependent versions is refused. Deleting the city's rule leaves existing trips intact and prevents new departures until a usable rule is available.

Keep the whole workspace

Export preserves source, compiled versions, references, city data and in-flight progress. It is a local file; this site does not store your work in the cloud. Reloading without an export loses your changes.

Build 001 images require the preserved Build 001 machine. Build 002 rejects an incompatible kernel image.

Start the machine to inspect it.
Exact raw input / output
Starting…

The general Thread terminal is trusted developer access. It can change any guest memory; module isolation is a language contract, not a security sandbox. Unbounded commands can exhaust the work budget.
